unit: USD (converted from INR crore at approx ₹83.5/USD — see notes); MT (from LMT)
source_name: APEDA export data as reported by ricenewstoday.com ('Indian basmati 24-25 exports up Rs1,923cr over last season')
notes: India supplies roughly 80% of world basmati rice trade, so 'world top importers' is effectively the same list as India's export destinations for this product. FY2024-25 total: 6.06 million tonnes, USD 5.94 billion (a separately reported aggregate; the six country values above sum to ~USD 3.92bn / do not sum to the reported USD 5.94bn total, meaning material volume goes to markets outside this top-6 list — treat these six as the top named destinations, not a full breakdown). INR→USD conversion used an approximate FY2024-25 average rate of ₹83.5/USD since the source reported rupee-crore figures; the source's own reported quantities (in lakh metric tonnes, LMT) were used directly for Saudi Arabia/Iraq/Iran. A separate 2025-26 source gave market-share percentages instead of dollar values (Saudi Arabia 16.6%, Iran 13.9%, Iraq 11.2%, UAE 8.2%, Yemen 5.7%) — consistent in ranking with the FY2024-25 figures used here. Recommend the owner cross-check exact figures against apeda.gov.in/BasmatiRice before publishing a priced comparison table.
